name: Spanish
note: Grade of C (2.0) or higher required in all courses counted toward the major. A minimum of eight courses in Spanish beyond Intermediate Spanish II (SPA-225); one class in translation (e.g. SPA-148, SPA-457, ENG-357, or other) may count as one of the eight. Elementary Spanish (SPA-115/125), Spanish Review and Preparation (SPA-135), and Intermediate Spanish (SPA-215/225) are skill-building courses and do not count toward the major. Students may substitute approved study abroad for up to three courses. Students selecting Spanish as a second teaching field should complete at least four Spanish courses numbered 315 or above.

sections.label: Introduction to Hispanic Literature or Hispanic Life and Culture
sections.description: Either SPA-345 or SPA-336/SPA-338 must be taken as part of the eight credits.

sections.label: Eight Courses Beyond SPA-225
sections.description: A minimum of eight courses in Spanish beyond SPA-225. One class in translation (SPA-148, SPA-457, ENG-357, or other) may count as one of the eight.
